_about: Curated fallback blurbs for Story Journal episodes whose /v2/stories 'description' (and sometimes 'timeline') the GW2 API leaves EMPTY - or returns JUNK like 'Summary of Chapter NN' (the module treats that as empty). Mostly the newest releases (Janthir Wilds, Visions of Eternity). The LIVE API ALWAYS WINS: the module only uses an entry here when the API field is blank/junk, so the day ArenaNet publishes the real text, ours is silently superseded. Keyed by the stable /v2/stories id. Maintainer notes live in builder/docs/journal-overrides.md.

36.description: The commander descends into the Tangled Depths and rallies the Nuhoch as Mordremoth's corruption tightens its grip on the jungle, closing in on a reckoning with the Elder Dragon.

120.description: The commander joins Gorrik in Gyala Delve to investigate the eerie haze and the demons rising from the Jade Brotherhood's deepest excavations.

122.description: Alongside Rama, Yao, Taimi, and Gorrik, the commander descends into Gyala Delve to confront the evil festering in its depths and free the Jade Brotherhood from its grip.

155.description: Summoned by Countess Anise, the commander journeys to the isles of Janthir and makes first contact with a lowland kodan colony and the Astral Ward, beginning to uncover the region's secrets and the threat stirring within it.

147.description: The commander travels to Harvest Den to learn the ways of the lowland kodan and earn the trust of their colony.

152.description: With newfound allies, the commander establishes a homestead in Janthir to serve as a base for the journey ahead.

146.description: The commander looks into a disappearance and picks up the trail of a mysterious stranger moving through the wilds.

154.description: The commander pursues the elusive threat as the kodan delegates vote on how their colony should respond.

149.description: The commander ventures deeper into the wilds of Janthir, surveying the land as a gathering danger looms over the isles.

150.description: A dangerous new threat strikes, and the commander races to protect their allies as the storm over Janthir breaks.

148.description: The commander works to restore balance to the wilds and tend to the creatures caught up in the turmoil.

145.description: The commander confronts the strangers behind the threat and rallies their allies to make a stand.

153.description: In the aftermath of the conflict, the commander carries grave news to Isgarren of the Wizard's Court.

172.description: The commander reunites with old friends in Lion's Arch and catches wind of covert Inquest voyages bound for a long-lost island.

168.description: The commander sets sail through treacherous fog toward the remote island of Castora, following the trail of an emerging Inquest conspiracy.

167.description: Newly ashore on Castora, the commander gets the lay of the land and meets the locals who call the island home.

165.description: The commander scouts an Inquest research facility on Castora, gathering intelligence on what drew them to the island.

166.description: The commander confronts an Inquest seneschal and begins to uncover the truth behind their work on Castora.

169.description: The commander infiltrates Inquest operations hidden beneath Castora's canopy.

173.description: Exploring Castora's ruins, the commander finds where ancient history and Inquest technology collide.

170.description: The commander delves into a shadowed basilica crypt to uncover the secrets Castora has kept hidden.

171.description: The commander races against the enemy, following the clues toward Castora's hidden heart at Ancora.
